newsitem.title: UK: Capital Corp receives rival bid inquiries.
newsitem.headline: Capital Corp receives rival bid inquiries.

text.p: British casino operator and hostile bid target, Capital Corporation, told the Financial Times on Thursday it had received inquiries from potential counter bidders.
On Monday, London Clubs International made a 181 million pound ($292.7 million) offer for the group which Capital said was unwelcome and undervalued the group.
Capital's chief executive Alan Hearn told the Financial Times: "We've had phone calls from a number of sources. But no direct approaches."
He said the company would consider counter offers if they were a true reflection of its value. ($1=.6184 Pound)
